name: Mercury Securities Group Berhad
overview: 今年 Mercury Securities Group Berhad 的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及地址变更，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新一季 (2026-07-31) 营收同比增长 35.3%，净利润同比增长 33.4%。
overview_en: This year, Mercury Securities Group Berhad's announcements mainly comprised quarterly results, general meetings and change of address, with no disclosure of expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract signing in any business segment. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew 35.3% year-on-year and net profit grew 33.4% year-on-year.
